summary: Keyframe animations are written in CSS. The HTML provides the elements to animate: here, a status dot and a progress bar.
notes: The empty <span class="dot"> is only decoration. The text next to it carries the meaning.
role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow tells screen readers the bar shows 18 of 24. They cannot see the width.
Nothing in the HTML starts the animation. The CSS runs it as soon as the page loads.
pitfall: Using motion as the only way to show information, like a blinking dot with no text. People who turn off animation, or use a screen reader, miss it.
